title: BuildingRequest
description: Input to the exterior generator. Units: meters. Building-local space, right-handed, +Y up, XZ floor plane, CCW polygons. Outputs share the footprint's coordinate frame, ground at Y=0.

footprint.description: CCW simple polygon [x, z], first point not repeated; the buildable boundary, structure never exceeds it

accessPoint.description: street access point from atlas; the main entrance lands on the facade nearest it

floorKinds.description: optional slot label per above-ground floor, length must equal floors (e.g. lobby, office, restaurant); synthesized when absent

theme.description: lowercase slug; material keys are theme/kind/tier

apertures.description: connections' aperture schema verbatim (../connections/schemas/aperture.schema.json). Face i = vertical quad over parcel footprint segment i -> i+1; face-local frame origin at vertex i at y=0, U along the segment, V along +Y. Exterior reads id, face, kind, base, cut (u/width/height cross-checked); a floor plate lands exactly at each base. wire-anchor cuts no hole: node anchor:<id> emitted at the cut center with its mount plate.

u.description: face-local U of the opening center

base.description: absolute y of the opening bottom

polygon.description: world-space loop, every vertex on the face plane

glb.description: named = contract node per part (canonical, inspectable); merged = one mesh per material key for runtime scale. Same blueprint either way.

balconyStyle.description: bay keeps one landing per door; full joins compatible doors on a face into one long band; auto selects by family, tier and seed

openFront.description: permanently open street frontage for eligible compact commerce, restaurant and coffee-shop buildings

entranceLayout.description: one public entrance by default; repeated fits coordinated doors along eligible long frontages when no open frontage is selected

fireEscape.description: auto lets the rule decide (a seeded few of the eligible buildings wear one); on forces it where the building is eligible, off never

facadeServices.description: dimensioned facade-local pipe and duct networks with attached junction units; auto is limited to compatible solid service facades

hangingClothes.description: supported clotheslines clear of openings and access routes; auto is limited to poor and mid residential facades

windowDamage.description: explicit opt-in pane damage; sparse selects at most one window per forty candidates and preserves its fitted frame

sunAzimuthDeg.description: facades facing this azimuth bias closed

overrides.description: exact per-opening controls; openPercent 30 produces closurePercent 70
